data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this beautifully furnished apartment in Orra Harbour, one of Dubai Marina’s most desirable waterfront communities.





  Offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience, this modern residence features elegant interiors, spacious living areas, and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light. Ideally positioned along the Marina waterfront, residents enjoy a vibrant lifestyle surrounded by world-class dining, retail, and leisure destinations.





  Property Features:





  • Fully Furnished
  • Modern Interior Design
  • Spacious Living and Dining Area
  • Fully Equipped Kitchen
  • Built-In Wardrobes
  • Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
  • Balcony
  • Covered Parking
  • Ready to Move In





  Building Amenities:





  • Rooftop Infinity Swimming Pool
  • Jacuzzi, Sauna and Spa Facilities
  • Fully Equipped Gymnasium
  • Running Track
  • Children’s Pool and Play Area
  • Games Room
  • 24/7 Security and Concierge Services
  • Hotel-Style Lobby
  • Pet-Friendly Community
  • High-Speed Elevators





  Orra Harbour is a premium waterfront development in the heart of Dubai Marina, comprising two contemporary residential towers connected by exceptional lifestyle facilities. Residents benefit from direct access to Marina attractions, restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, Marina Walk, JBR Beach, Dubai Marina Mall, and major road networks.





  The development is known for its resort-style atmosphere, rooftop leisure facilities, spacious layouts, and prime waterfront setting, making it an excellent choice for both end-users and investors seeking a vibrant Marina lifestyle. Most residences enjoy expansive balconies and beautiful Marina and community views, creating a unique urban waterfront living experience.
